clusters.title: Jio delivers 21% surprise. Buy or sell now?
clusters.description: Shares of Jio Platforms, the country’s largest public offer to date, listed at Rs 1,358 on BSE and NSE on Wednesday, an impressive 21.36% premium over the IPO price of Rs 1,119 per share. Jio Platforms’ IPO, with an issue size around Rs 30,200 crore, generated cumulative demand of more than Rs 7 lakh crore across the anchor and public book-building process.The IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. Its Rs 5,500 crore qualified institutional buyer portion was booked within the first 10 minutes. At the close of the third day, the IPO had been subscribed 22.2 times, while the QIB portion was subscribed 70.55 times. Against the 27 crore shares offered, aggregate demand stood at 655.68 crore shares.
